collection_notes: Gaston city website (cityofgaston.com) blocks automated fetch. The Oregon Blue Book city page (T1, sos.oregon.gov) lists the mayor as Bill Martin and gives no council roster. Only William Martin has a statement in the Gaston section (WC-14) of the county pamphlet (confirmed by reading the pamphlet with offset 40000). Step 4/5 searches returned only unrelated people or crime stories. Inventory had incumbent=null; Blue Book lists 'Bill Martin' as mayor and his pamphlet lists 'Mayor' and 'City Council' as prior experience, so incumbent=true (Blue Book page is undated; reviewer may confirm). Pamphlet footer spells 'Wiliam Martin'.
